items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 23 at 6:06AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
A band of moisture will move through the Interior Monday and
Tuesday, bringing with it warmer air and periods of widespread
rainfall which could approach upwards of an inch for some
locations. Cooling conditions during the  overnight hours,
especially after the system departs, will lead to refreezing of
snow-melt and rain on roadways, creating particularly slick and
slippery conditions.
